provenance.source_ref: utterance_sentence_5: metrics/review 命中率闭环，发布人工门

acceptance_criteria.theme: `skills/prism-produce/references/title-lab.md` 存在；含路径 A（6 条候选标题，覆盖 ≥6 种公式 + 1 首选）与路径 B（4 个选题方向，模板不重复）；含硬规则（空数字 / 震惊体 / 编造社会证明 / 同义改写禁止）与「正文兑现点」约束；出声口径为 Prism 自己的规则，不含整段上游原文。
`skills/prism-intel/references/briefing-schema.md` 增补「选题角度 + 标题公式建议」小节：每个选题角度给出对应公式/模板候选，并注明由 produce 侧 title-lab 执行。
`skills/prism-qa/references/anti-slop-gate.md` 增「标题门」：检查空数字、震惊体、无法兑现、同义改写；`skills/_internal/orchestration/quality-gates.md` Gate 4 增「标题门 pass」条件：公式覆盖 ≥6、标题 18–32 字、工具名前 16 字、附赠物有正文兑现。
`docs/ATTRIBUTION-corpora.md` 存在，含 MIT 许可声明、上游仓库地址与核实日期；标题语料样本以校准层落盘（`skills/prism-produce/references/title-corpus.md`），标注来源与检索日期；仓库 LICENSE 随附上游 MIT 文本。
`contracts/metrics-publication.contract.md` 增 `title_formula` 与 `is_preferred` 跟踪字段；`contracts/review-loop.contract.md` 增「每 4 周对比标题公式命中的基线」条目；发布仍须人工批准（release 人工门不变）。

test_rows.command: `test -f skills/prism-produce/references/title-lab.md && rg -q '路径 A|路径 B|同义改写|首选' skills/prism-produce/references/title-lab.md`
`rg -q '选题角度.*标题公式建议|标题公式建议' skills/prism-intel/references/briefing-schema.md`
`rg -q '标题门' skills/prism-qa/references/anti-slop-gate.md && rg -q '标题门' skills/_internal/orchestration/quality-gates.md && rg -q '同义改写|18–32|前 16 字' skills/prism-qa/references/anti-slop-gate.md`

`test -f docs/ATTRIBUTION-corpora.md && rg -q 'MIT|BigPengSays' docs/ATTRIBUTION-corpora.md && test -f skills/prism-produce/references/title-corpus.md && rg -q '来源|检索' skills/prism-produce/references/title-corpus.md`
`rg -q 'title_formula|is_preferred' contracts/metrics-publication.contract.md && rg -q '4 周|基线' contracts/review-loop.contract.md && rg -q '人工' contracts/review-loop.contract.md`
`rg -q 'Illegal transitions|illegal' docs/beacon/v0.0.1/features/prism-title-lab-v1/truth.md && rg -q '跳过标题门|未人工批准' docs/beacon/v0.0.1/features/prism-title-lab-v1/truth.md`
`python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path('skills/prism-produce/references/title-lab.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert '首选' in t and '公式' in t and '兑现' in t; print('ok')"`
test_rows.assertion: exit 0 且 stdout 含 ok
